message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Six relevant vulnerability findings were verified for the deduplicated primary product inventory during the 24-hour window. The highest-priority items are the Critical Chrome flaw and the two High-severity PyCharm and ManageEngine disclosures.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` plus `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. Obvious aliases and duplicate rows were normalized; administrative project text was excluded. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-30 05:10 IST through 2026-10-31 05:10 IST (2026-10-29 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-30 23:40 UTC).

### Google Chrome: 21 security fixes, including CVE-2026-76024

- **Severity:** 1 Critical, 19 High, 1 Medium (Google ratings)
- **Description:** Chrome before 156.0.8078.79 contains memory-safety and input-validation flaws across MediaStream, FileSystem, Autofill, CacheStorage, Network, Input, Skia, V8, DOM, and other components. The Critical issue is CVE-2026-76024, memory corruption in MediaStream.
- **Relevance:** Google Chrome is explicitly monitored. The associated CVE records were published in-window; Google’s stable update fixes the listed issues in 156.0.8078.79/.80.
- **Source:** [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/10/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_02107719452.html)

### Microsoft Edge: CVE-2026-69446

- **Severity:** Moderate, CVSS 3.1 score 4.4
- **Description:** Incorrect authorization can allow an authorized local attacker to elevate privileges in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge.
- **Relevance:** Microsoft Edge is explicitly monitored. Microsoft also released Edge Stable 156.0.4314.58 on October 30 with current Chromium security updates; its release note said the detailed CVE list was still pending.
- **Sources:** [CVE/GitHub advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6jfw-hgqc-f449), [Microsoft Edge security release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnotes-security)

### JetBrains PyCharm: CVE-2026-118696

- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 8.0
- **Description:** The embedded browser in affected JetBrains IDEs, including PyCharm, trusted revoked eMudhra intermediate certificates, potentially allowing a network-positioned attacker to compromise confidentiality and integrity when user interaction occurs.
- **Relevance:** PyCharm is explicitly monitored. Affected PyCharm builds are those before 2026.3, 2026.2.4, 2026.1.5.1, and 2025.3.6.2.
- **Source:** [JetBrains-referenced CVE advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c5hv-w26w-w8h7)

### Prometheus: CVE-2026-119566

- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 3.1 score 4.8
- **Description:** Prometheus through 3.15.1 can forward Azure AD or Google IAM bearer tokens across hosts when a `remote_write` endpoint redirects requests, allowing an attacker controlling the endpoint or redirect target to capture and replay the token.
- **Relevance:** Prometheus is explicitly monitored. The issue maps directly to its remote-write client and official Prometheus code.
- **Sources:** [CVE record summary and references](https://cvetracker.app/cve/CVE-2026-119566), [Prometheus common pull request](https://github.com/prometheus/common/pull/901)

### ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus: CVE-2026-119680

- **Severity:** High, CVSS 4.0 score 8.5
- **Description:** Stored cross-site scripting in chart generation can execute attacker-supplied HTML or JavaScript in another user’s browser when affected charts are viewed.
- **Relevance:** ManageEngine is in the monitored inventory. SharePoint Manager Plus builds before 4508 are identified as affected; the vendor’s build 4508 release notes contain the fix.
- **Sources:** [CVE record](https://db.gcve.eu/vuln/CVE-2026-119680), [ManageEngine release notes](https://www.manageengine.com/sharepoint-management-reporting/release-notes.html)

### ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus: CVE-2026-119682

- **Severity:** High, CVSS 4.0 score 7.9
- **Description:** Missing authorization in MFA administration can let a low-privileged authenticated user read or change MFA settings, enumerate enrolled users, or delete enrolled accounts, weakening authentication or causing lockout.
- **Relevance:** ManageEngine is in the monitored inventory. Builds before 4507 are affected; the vendor’s build 4507 release notes describe the authorization fix.
- **Sources:** [CVE record](https://app.opencve.io/cve/CVE-2026-119682), [ManageEngine release notes](https://www.manageengine.com/sharepoint-management-reporting/release-notes.html)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB’s security alerts, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly reported in this exact window; the newest MongoDB security alerts located were dated October 22 and were excluded as stale.

### Possible matches needing review

None. Plugin-only WordPress findings, similarly named products, and disclosures whose authoritative timestamps fell before the cutoff were excluded.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for Chrome because the release contains a Critical flaw, and prompt review is recommended for affected PyCharm and ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus installations. Edge and Prometheus should follow normal risk-based review based on deployed versions and exposure.
